Class RecordBook

    • canGoOnFreeStudying

      public boolean canGoOnFreeStudying()
      Determines whether the student can continue on free studying.

      The result is true when the record book contains at least two semesters, all gradable subjects in the last and previous semesters have good marks, and all credits are passed.

      Returns:
      true if the student can continue on free studying; otherwise false

    • canGetRedDiploma

      public boolean canGetRedDiploma()
      Determines whether the student can receive a red diploma.

      The result is true when all credits are passed, no gradable subject has mark Mark.THREE, the qualifying work is absent or marked Mark.FIVE, and, from the eighth semester onward, at least 75 percent of gradable subjects are marked Mark.FIVE.

      Returns:
      true if the student can receive a red diploma; otherwise false

    • canGetIncreasedScholarship

      public boolean canGetIncreasedScholarship()
      Determines whether the student can receive an increased scholarship.

      The result is true when the record book contains at least two semesters and all marks in the last semester are excellent.

      Returns:
      true if the student can receive an increased scholarship; otherwise false
